_comment: Domains whose links belong in a desktop app rather than a browser window. Adding an app is one object: the bundle id macOS launches, and the hosts it claims. Hosts match themselves and any subdomain, so 'notion.so' covers 'www.notion.so'. List the app's associated domains, not the vendor's whole domain: a host the app does not claim is handed over and silently ignored. Leave Google's own domains out: a Drive or Docs link has to keep the account's browser profile, which is the whole point of the profile setting.
